models_evaluated: 7B clinical LLM with Neurosymbolic Alignment (HGNN Physiological World Model + iterative on-policy ORPO)

links.outcome: Safety score (CSS) under synthetic EHR-style input noise
links.effect: 84.2% CSS retained under synthetic EHR-style noise, versus 90.8% CSS on clean benchmark inputs (a drop of about 6.6 pp).
links.quote: Under synthetic EHR-style noise, 84.2% CSS is retained.

unlisted_practices: Training-time preference optimization grounded in a biomedical knowledge graph and physiological constraints (neurosymbolic alignment) to reduce physiologically unsafe clinical LLM outputs
Rule-engine based independent safety scoring to corroborate model-based safety metrics

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a training-time alignment methodology (Neurosymbolic Alignment using a Physiological World Model) for clinical LLMs against a benchmark dataset (Clinical Safety Benchmark).
